title: FailedTakeRule v2 — with evidence_source
description: Extends the proposed FailedTakeRule schema to require a cited evidence source for each outcome. Without evidence_source, an unknown or fail outcome cannot be reproduced by a reviewer.

predicate.example: Final close-up eye-pixel hue falls outside source-frame range.

evidence_source.description: Frame ID, timestamp, record ID or method citation supporting this outcome. Required; null only when outcome is unknown AND the reason for unknownability is stated in unknown_reason.
evidence_source.example: still_frame_17:500 — eye pixel HSV hue 0.98, source-frame hue 0.62

unknown_reason.description: When outcome is unknown, states why evidence_source could not be obtained (e.g. no playback access, audio not reviewed).
unknown_reason.example: No playback access; audio not reviewed (art_01M64VKPP8M9QBQAAF5ABJ758Y r2).

promotable.description: True only when evidence_source is non-null and outcome is pass or fail.

examples.predicate: Final close-up eye-pixel hue falls outside source-frame hue range (grey-blue to red shift detectable).
examples.evidence_source: still_frame_17:500 — hue shift confirmed; source: art_01M64VKPP8M9QBQAAF5ABJ758Y r2, run 2

examples.predicate: Audio does not contain third-party music.
examples.unknown_reason: Audio not reviewed in any of the three runs. See art_01M64VKPP8M9QBQAAF5ABJ758Y r2 explicit caution.
